## 1165179c0d2e

**Reproduced semantic distribution defect — fixed-bottom-row shortcut.** The generator documentation says marker position varies, but the selected sampler writes the unique color-2 marker at `(height-1, 0)` on every normal draw and samples distinct component sizes only. A rival can therefore ignore the marker entirely and always draw the sorted size bars on the last row beginning at column 1.

I sampled 100 actual generator draws in each of easy, medium, and hard (300 total). All 300 passed the target's weak `self_check`; all 300 had the marker at bottom/column zero; all 300 had distinct component sizes; and the fixed-bottom rival matched an independent implementation of the intended rule on all 300.

The exact counterexample is canonical pair index 1. It has marker `(9,1)` in a `12×12` grid and repeated component sizes `[4,4,1]`. The target validator accepts it. Real Racket follows the marker; the fixed-bottom rival does not, producing **17 differing cells**. Full input, Racket output, rival output, source/rule hashes, sampling schedule, and command are retained in `checks/audit-1165179c0d2e-counterexample.json`.

This target was not modified. A repair should vary marker row and column constructively, allow tied component sizes, strengthen `self_check`, and add executable shortcut witnesses rather than merely broadening random grid dimensions.

triage.reason: Both assigned findings independently reproduced against unchanged bound source hashes. 1165179c0d2e: 300/300 fixed marker/tied-size exclusion draws; actual canonical Racket counterexample differs in 17 cells and passes weak validator. Next repair: varying marker row/column, size ties and strict validation plus named rival witnesses. d17f2bbc0878: 300/300 erase-other-colors shortcut-compatible draws; actual Racket preserves an interior majority cell (one-cell disagreement); validator rejects witness and 4/4 canonical inputs. Next repair: remove unsupported bbox separation and schedule interior non-minority cells. Audit targets left unchanged; replay receipts in batch25a.
